narrative:
Sandusky County has 38,675 registered voters, with 17.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 44.8%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 14.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.9% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -7.2% D−R vs -20.8% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
